fetched_title: Prior Audit-Repair Context Shifts LLM Verifier Thresholds Toward Leniency
summary: Measures false alarms of a verifier on human-verified-correct ProcessBench traces and finds a completed audit-repair episode in context lowers them in 15 of 15 model-wording combinations, with the shift located in the decision threshold rather than discrimination. Single-trace verification with no candidate pools and no target-absent pools.
